_note: Label-free class descriptions for the 5 PTB-XL diagnostic superclasses. Written 2026-10-21 before any prompt-based evaluation was run, and frozen (committed) before evaluation. German prompts use umlauts, matching the reports' orthography (fixed before any evaluation). Never selected or edited using results. Index i within a language is paraphrase i, so prompt i across classes forms one classifier. The pre-registered readout is the ensemble over all 8 prompts per class (both languages); single-prompt and per-language results are reported as variation.

STTC: st depression and t wave inversion
CD: left anterior fascicular block or bundle branch block
